issues.description: Function detect_errors: the declared return type differs between artifacts. The problem statement (and the reference solution) specify detect_errors(measurements, checks) -> npt.NDArray[np.int8] (a numpy ndarray of dtype int8) and describe returning a 1-D ndarray marking shots with no detected error. The template implementation declares the return type as list[int] and its docstring describes returning a list, causing a type/signature mismatch. This mismatch will confuse students about the expected return value and can cause test failures or extra work converting types.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template's detect_errors signature and documentation match the problem statement and solution by changing the return annotation to npt.NDArray[np.int8] and updating the docstring to state it returns a numpy ndarray of dtype int8 (1-D array with 1 for good shots and 0 for detected errors). Example: def detect_errors(...) -> npt.NDArray[np.int8]: and ensure implementations/tests treat the result as an ndarray. Alternatively, update problem text/tests to accept list[int], but prefer the ndarray to match the reference solution and numerical array usage.
